in_sanskrit.name: निलेशकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord Shiva as the young boy

in_marathi.name: Nileshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nileshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nileshkumar is a Sanskrit name composed of two words: Nilesh and Kumar. Nilesh means 'Lord of the Gods', and Kumar refers to 'younger brother of God Shiva'. Thus, Nileshkumar represents the divine brother of the God of Destruction.
